data.title: Argentina coach Lionel Scaloni opens door to contract extension and preps for Messi farewell - Bozeman Daily Chronicle
data.content: # Argentina coach Lionel Scaloni opens door to contract extension and preps for Messi farewell. ## Argentina coach Lionel Scaloni is open to extending his contract which expires in December. Scaloni who led Argentina to a World Cup title and two Copa América victories plans to discuss terms with the Argentine Football Association president. The match against Benin will be Lionel Messi's final game for the national team. Lionel Scaloni, who hinted his tenure as Argentina coach was over following the loss in the World Cup final, said Thursday he is willing to negotiate an extension of his contract, which expires in December. “We will talk — there is every willingness to sit down,” Scaloni told reporters after a training session at the national team complex in Ezeiza, ahead of friendlies against Bolivia, Burkina Faso, and Benin. Scaloni’s remarks came after several Argentine national team players publicly called for him to stay, including the new captain, Cristian Romero, who is taking over the armband following the international retirement of Lionel Messi.
